summary: Viewed all four supplied PNGs, including the native 1x and nearest 3x pose panels. The gat, short pale beard, broad robe and separate wooden shaft/black bristles form a readable silhouette. Broad shoulder highlights and shaded sleeves support upper-left lighting; the dark brush and shoes lose some definition on the dark background. No obvious unintended transparent body holes or missing limb outlines were visible on the checker panels. Standing soles share the ground line, the stride opens clearly, and the prone death pose is distinct. Windup, stride, diagonal strike and horizontal recovery read as a related brush attack; hit recoil is relatively restrained. The skill has a brush-tip preparation, an attached ink fan with three asymmetric outgoing masses, and raised-brush droplets. Poison uses a hand at the face, stun uses a slack arm and stars, and sleep uses a seated, closed-eye posture; these are authored states rather than tints or unrelated attacks. However, the skill recovery grip and both poison grips do not convincingly hold the visible shaft. Repair those local connections. This is a visual recommendation, not a user selection. Static previews cannot establish animation timing, actual battle contact, runtime hop motion, alpha compliance or literal-grid authorship.
